faq.a: Every rental includes full CASCO + RCA coverage at no extra cost. Theft, third-party damage and roadside assistance are covered. No optional packages, no upsells — the price you see is what you pay.

faq.q: How much is the security deposit?
faq.a: €200 for Economy and Sedan, €350 for SUV and Crossover, €500 for Premium SUV. Held against the card on pickup, fully released within 24 hours of return.
Free delivery anywhere in Nicosia and at Larnaca International Airport (LCA). For deliveries outside the city, we charge €0.40 / km from city center. Available 24/7.

faq.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
faq.a: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup — full refund, no questions. Inside 24 hours: 50% refund. Date changes are free at any time, subject to availability.
Valid passport or national ID, valid driver's license held for at least 2 years, and a credit or debit card in the driver's name for the deposit. International licenses accepted.
Drivers must be at least 21 years old with 2+ years of driving experience. No surcharge for young drivers. Multiple drivers can be added free of charge.
300 km per day included. Beyond that, €0.20/km. Weekly and monthly rentals come with unlimited mileage in Cyprus at no extra cost.

faq.q: Can I drive across the whole island?
faq.a: Yes — drive anywhere in the Republic of Cyprus: Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca, Paphos, Ayia Napa, the Troodos mountains. Crossing into Northern Cyprus is not covered by insurance and is not permitted with rental cars.
